theme.name: graphite
theme.direction: Cool violet-grey on Tailwind zinc's hue and chroma shape
theme.serialization: rgb channels with three decimal places

families.name: Graphite
families.note: Cool violet-grey on Tailwind zinc's hue and chroma. The restrained default.
warnings: primary-on-floating-surface: light and dark differ 2.004x in contrast (18.941:1 vs 9.452:1); the hierarchy is not the same in both themes.
field-focus-from-resting-edge: light and dark differ 1.756x in contrast (3.697:1 vs 6.492:1); the hierarchy is not the same in both themes.
tooltip-ink: light and dark differ 2.004x in contrast (18.941:1 vs 9.452:1); the hierarchy is not the same in both themes.
primary-to-floating-surface: light and dark differ 3.001x in separation (0.022398 vs 0.06721).
surface-chroma: dark surfaces average 2.669x the chroma of light surfaces (0.003026 vs 0.008077).
